name: Convert Tax
original_name: コンバート・タックス
source:
Convert Tax is the former second in command of the Helman 2nd Army, working directly under [url=/c97997]Aristoles Calm[/url]. He's pretty greedy and selfish.

[spoiler]He's actually mostly loyal to [url=/c97996]Stessel Romanov[/url] and was put in the 2nd Army to keep an eye on the General Aristoles, who directly opposes Stessel and his investigation to reveal Stessel's acts of corruption could be troublesome.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Convert_Tax]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
